name: katharsis
description: An output style that classifies each message by exchange type and shapes the reply to fit it: the answer first, a ceiling per type, reference codes that survive the session, and decisions handed back as questions

autonomy.title: Autonomy level
autonomy.description: Which actions Claude takes without asking you first, when it cannot infer your answer from what you said, your repo's conventions, or preferences you stated earlier. guided (default): the style's "When a call is mine" test as written, which counts every push, PR, and message to a colleague as expensive enough to be your call. standard: further publishing inside a scope you approved this session goes ahead, such as another push to a branch you approved pushing; starting something new that publishes, and messaging people, including a comment, a review reply, or a review request on a PR, stay your call. autonomous: everything standard allows, plus pushing a branch the work created and opening or updating a PR from it by adding commits, once the work is verified (a push to the default branch or someone else's branch, and opening or updating a PR against a repo you can't push to, including a push to that PR's branch, are not part of this); every other action that is your call at guided stays your call, such as merging, deleting data Claude did not create this session, any force-push, even to that branch, spending money, and messaging people, including a comment, a review reply, or a review request on a PR.
